editorial:
Imagine waking up one day feeling like the most beautiful person on the planet, even though nothing about your look actually changed. That is exactly what happens to Renee, a woman who struggles with low self-esteem and feels invisible to the world. After a freak accident at the gym leaves her with a bump on the head, she suddenly sees a supermodel in the mirror. The vibe is light, bubbly, and mostly just a fun ride. You get to watch her go from a shy wallflower to a bold powerhouse who takes charge of her life and career, all because she finally believes she is worth it.

Amy Schumer does a great job making you root for her, and the pacing keeps things moving quickly so you never get bored. While the plot is a bit predictable, the message about inner beauty hits home. It is a perfect pick for a girls night in or when you just need a feel-good laugh. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those bright, popping colors. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a solid bet for a rainy day.
endingExplained: At the end, Renee has another accident that knocks her back to reality. She realizes that she never actually looked different to other people; the change was all in her head. She gives a big speech about how confidence is what really matters. She makes up with her friends and starts dating the guy she likes, accepting herself exactly as she is. It wraps up with a happy message that beauty comes from within.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted comedies about self-love and confidence.
